  const nextFloor=bot.blockAt(q.offset(0,-1,0)),b=bot.blockAt(q);
  const sides=dirs.map(d=>bot.blockAt(q.plus(d)));

  if(!reserve())return {reason:'NO_HELD_CAP_BEFORE_CUT',steps:k,p};

 }return {reason:'STEP_BUDGET',steps,p:bot.entity.position};

function guardedMovement(sprint=false){const hazards=foes();const m=new Movements(bot);m.canDig=true;for(const b of bot.registry.blocksArray)if(!b.name.endsWith('_leaves')&&!['snow','short_grass','fern'].includes(b.name))m.blocksCantBreak.add(b.id);m.canOpenDoors=false;m.allowSprinting=false;m.allowParkour=true;m.allow1by1towers=false;m.scafoldingBlocks=[];m.maxDropDown=3;for(const n of['water','lava','fire','soul_fire','magma_block','sweet_berry_bush','powder_snow','cactus','nether_portal'])if(bot.registry.blocksByName[n])m.blocksToAvoid.add(bot.registry.blocksByName[n].id);m.exclusionAreasStep.push(b=>{const p=b.position||new Vec3(b.x,b.y,b.z);let c=0;for(const e of hazards){if(Math.abs(e.position.y-p.y)>3&&!['skeleton','stray','witch'].includes(e.name))continue;const d=e.position.distanceTo(p),r=e.name==='creeper'?11:['skeleton','stray','witch'].includes(e.name)?16:7;if(d<r)c+=(r-d)*20;}return c});bot.pathfinder.setMovements(m);bot.pathfinder.thinkTimeout=500;}
async function guardedWalk(ms=60000,forceAfterMs=null,target={x:148.5,z:2212.5},nightTrial=false){const hp0=bot.health;let hurt=false,buried=false,phase='WALK',flee=false,lastPlan=0,started=Date.now(),last=bot.entity.position.clone(),progress=Date.now();const onHealth=()=>{if(bot.health<hp0-.25)hurt=true};bot.on('health',onHealth);try{guardedMovement();while(Date.now()-started<ms){life();if(Math.hypot(target.x-bot.entity.position.x,target.z-bot.entity.position.z)<.7){phase='TARGET';break}const e=contactThreat(),late=!nightTrial&&bot.time.timeOfDay>=10000,forced=forceAfterMs!==null&&Date.now()-started>=forceAfterMs;const shouldBury=e||hurt||late||forced||Date.now()-started>ms-8000;if(shouldBury){const why=e?'PROXIMITY_'+e.name:hurt?'HURT':late?'BEFORE_NIGHT':forced?'CONTROLLED':'BUDGET';if(await immediateBurial(why)||await nativeRefuge()||await surfaceBox(why)){buried=true;phase='BURIED';break}flee=!!e||hurt;}
